column1: # check_test_constant_conversions's programs (c_check_constant_conversion_test.c; #2678): ID, FILE, FLAGS, NAME, tab-separated.
# Each runs natively against clang's build of it; its NAME selects the checks of its entries and code.
# The issue's four functions, their code checked: first in the unit, then a driver whose own conversions are of no constant.
# Every kind of conversion that folds into its constant's CONST, a conditional's and a logical operator's arms' among them: no integer CONST then precedes a CONVERT.
# Conversions that keep their entries: rounding ones, a conditional's of no constant arm or to double after the label joining them, and of the memory classes.
